title: Managing Stress During Ramadan Fasting
paragraphs: Selama Ramadan pertamanya sambil bekerja di pekerjaan yang menuntut, Anas kesulitan mengelola puasa sekaligus jadwal rapat yang padat, sering merasa mudah tersinggung menjelang sore meski sudah berusaha maksimal.

Seorang rekan kerja yang berpengalaman bertahun-tahun menyeimbangkan keduanya menyarankan untuk menjadwalkan ulang tugas paling menuntut ke pagi hari, saat energinya secara alami lebih tinggi setelah Sahur.

Anas juga mulai mengambil jeda singkat untuk beristirahat dengan tenang alih-alih memaksakan diri melewati kelelahan, yang mengejutkannya justru membuatnya lebih produktif selama jam ia benar-benar bekerja.

Menjelang minggu terakhir Ramadan, Anas telah mengembangkan ritme yang berkelanjutan, menyadari bahwa bekerja dengan cara berbeda saat berpuasa, alih-alih bekerja dengan cara yang sama persis sambil mengabaikan tubuhnya, membuat semua perbedaan.
answerKey: During his first Ramadan while working a demanding job, Anas struggled to manage both fasting and a heavy meeting schedule, often feeling irritable by mid-afternoon despite his best efforts. A colleague who had years of experience balancing both suggested rescheduling his most demanding tasks to the morning, when his energy was naturally higher after Suhoor. Anas also started taking short breaks to rest quietly rather than pushing through fatigue, which surprisingly made him more productive during the hours he was actually working. By the final week of Ramadan, Anas had developed a sustainable rhythm, realizing that working differently during fasting, rather than working the exact same way while ignoring his body, made all the difference.
